fields.label: serialization us
fields.description: Actual UART serialization time = wire bit periods / binary UART baud times1e6, excluding actual gaps/flow stalls.

fields.label: gap bound us
fields.description: Actual aggregate character/message/turnaround idle bound, unknown; zero only when explicitly justified.
fields.source_revision: Microchip TB3216 DS90003216B 2019 sections2/3/6; Arduino official Serial.begin reference master read2026-10-01; AVR USART frame-format documentation7.1.1 section15.5

fields.label: flow control
fields.description: Actual UART flow control and peer support, unknown. No automatic disabled flow-control assumption.

fields.label: flow bound us
fields.description: Actual bounded UART flow-control blocking from both endpoints, unknown. Unbounded peer stalls do not prove capacity.

fields.label: wire bound us
fields.description: Actual complete UART transfer bound at least serialization+aggregate idle+flow stalls, unknown; driver/application processing remains separate.

fields.label: clock hz
fields.description: Actual synchronous serial clock, unknown. Encoding/bits per clock/edge/role/word lengths supplied by actual bound port; never UART baud or USB speed.

fields.label: cdc line coding role
fields.description: Actual CDC implementation interpretation of line coding, unknown. Arduino native CDC ignores Serial.begin baud for wire speed; USB-to-UART bridges require separate real UART binding.

fields.description: Actual application message framing, unknown; optional line delimiters in TB3216 example are not mandatory for all serial streams.
